a: Use the body to explain why, not just what.
Mark commits good/bad so bisect can narrow the regression.
git worktree list shows linked working trees.
Cone mode simplifies sparse checkout patterns.
Blob filters reduce initial clone size.
git maintenance start enables background maintenance.
Trailers add structured footers like Reviewed-by.
Detached HEAD points directly at a commit, not a branch.
git restore --staged unstages without discarding worktree changes.
